# lightdash_user_attribute (Resource)

Manages a Lightdash user attribute. User attributes let you associate custom values with users and groups so that row-level security rules and other dynamic filters can reference them. This resource supports creating, updating, and deleting the attribute, along with the set of user and group assignments attached to it. Use `attribute_default` to define a fallback value for users or groups that do not have an explicit assignment.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "lightdash_user_attribute" "simple" {
  name              = "department"
  description       = "The department the user belongs to"
  attribute_default = "unknown"
}

resource "lightdash_user_attribute" "with_assignments" {
  name              = "region"
  description       = "Sales region assigned to the user"
  attribute_default = "global"

  users = [
    {
      user_uuid = "xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx"
      value     = "apac"
    },
    {
      user_uuid = "yyyyyyyy-yyyy-yyyy-yyyy-yyyyyyyyyyyy"
      value     = "emea"
    },
  ]

  groups = [
    {
      group_uuid = "zzzzzzzz-zzzz-zzzz-zzzz-zzzzzzzzzzzz"
      value      = "na"
    },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the user attribute.

### Optional

- `attribute_default` (String) The default value of the user attribute. Set to `null` to have no default.
- `description` (String) The description of the user attribute.
- `groups` (Attributes Set) A set of group-specific values for this attribute. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--groups))
- `users` (Attributes Set) A set of user-specific values for this attribute. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--users))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) The timestamp when the user attribute was created.
- `id` (String) The resource identifier. It is computed as `organizations/<organization_uuid>/attributes/<user_attribute_uuid>`.
- `organization_uuid` (String) The UUID of the Lightdash organization.
- `user_attribute_uuid` (String) The UUID of the Lightdash user attribute.

<a id="nestedatt--groups"></a>
### Nested Schema for `groups`

Required:

- `group_uuid` (String) The UUID of the Lightdash group.
- `value` (String) The attribute value assigned to the group.


<a id="nestedatt--users"></a>
### Nested Schema for `users`

Required:

- `user_uuid` (String) The UUID of the Lightdash user.
- `value` (String) The attribute value assigned to the user.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# User attributes can be imported by specifying the resource identifier.
terraform import lightdash_user_attribute.example "organizations/${organization_uuid}/attributes/${user_attribute_uuid}"
```
